raw:
@q query
  mode every
  where match
    relation "pay the thermal rehabilitation fee"
    role subject ?o
    role location "bl. P12, sc. B"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  quantifier at_least half
  claim ?o equal half
  task possible

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "be able to sign the contract with the contractor"
    role subject "the association"
    polarity affirmed
  end
